crossRefs.note: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”

translations.web: So Ahab sent to all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together to Mount Carmel.
translations.bsb: So Ahab summoned all the Israelites and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.
